zh.title: 烏情報單位指俄羅斯進口7萬噸Jet A-1航空燃油
zh.summary: 烏克蘭情報指出俄國進口七萬噸航空燃油；伊爾76運輸機據報改用Jet A-1燃料
body: 烏克蘭國防情報局（DIU）於2026年8月29日表示，由於國內煉油廠遭受襲擊導致航空燃油產量下降，俄羅斯已自韓國與埃及進口約7萬噸Jet A-1航空燃料。情報部門指出，相關進口燃料已在俄羅斯國防部操作的伊爾-76MD-90A（Il-76MD-90A）軍用運輸機上被記錄到使用情況。
根據烏克蘭國防情報局資訊，配備PS-90A-76發動機的伊爾-76MD-90A運輸機已開始使用Jet A-1燃料，而非該機型原先規定的TS-1航空煤油。情報機構補充說明，Jet A-1燃料亦可供MiG-29、Su-30SM、Su-34、Su-35S、Su-57、Su-24M與Tu-95MS/MSM等多款俄軍機型使用，並識別出Geran-4與Geran-5噴射動力無人機為潛在使用者。
情報資料顯示，共有三艘油輪於2026年8月將燃料運抵俄羅斯港口。其中，油輪Astoria號於8月初自韓國蔚山運送近1.1萬噸燃料抵達海參崴；另兩艘油輪Hanna號與Capibara號則自埃及德海拉港（El Dekheila）共同運送5.9萬噸燃料至聖彼得堡。烏克蘭情報部門將這三艘船隻歸類為俄羅斯影子艦隊的一部分。
路透社於8月28日報導指出，持續的無人機襲擊已干擾俄羅斯多家主要煉油廠的營運，導致8月下旬國內汽油產量降至預估需求量的七成左右。俄羅斯對航空燃油的出口禁令將持續實施至2026年11月底，在限制出口以維護國內供應的同時，亦從海外尋求成品航空渦輪燃料補給。

en.title: Ukraine Intelligence: Russia Imports 70,000 Tons of Jet Fuel Amid Refinery Disruptions
en.summary: Ukraine intelligence states Russia imported 70,000 tons of Jet A-1 fuel; Il-76MD-90A aircraft reportedly using imports
body: Ukraine’s Defense Intelligence (DIU) reported on August 29, 2026, that Russia has imported approximately 70,000 tons of Jet A-1 aviation fuel from South Korea and Egypt following a decline in domestic jet-fuel production caused by repeated attacks on oil refineries. The Ukrainian intelligence agency stated that the imported aviation fuel has already been documented aboard Russian Il-76MD-90A military transport aircraft operated by the Russian Ministry of Defense.

According to DIU, the Il-76MD-90A transport aircraft, which are powered by PS-90A-76 engines, have been utilizing Jet A-1 fuel instead of TS-1 aviation kerosene, the standard fuel specified for the airframe. The intelligence agency noted that Jet A-1 can also be used by several other Russian military aircraft, including the MiG-29, Su-30SM, Su-34, Su-35S, Su-57, Su-24M, and Tu-95MS/MSM, as well as jet-powered UAVs.

Ukrainian intelligence identified three tankers that delivered the fuel to Russian ports during August 2026. The tanker Astoria reportedly transported nearly 11,000 tons from Ulsan, South Korea, to Vladivostok in early August, while two other vessels, Hanna and Capibara, delivered a combined 59,000 tons from Egypt’s El Dekheila port to St. Petersburg. DIU stated that the vessels are part of Russia’s shadow fleet operating through foreign supply networks.

Reuters reported on August 28 that repeated drone strikes had disrupted operations at several major Russian refineries, pushing domestic fuel production down to approximately 70% of estimated demand by late August. In response to the refining disruptions, Russia has maintained strict restrictions on fuel exports, including a ban on jet-fuel exports that remains in place through the end of November 2026.

zh.title: 新加坡航空空中巴士A380航線公布：涵蓋倫敦與雪梨等10條航線
zh.summary: 新加坡航空公布A380航線網絡，以倫敦與雪梨為核心，並涵蓋印度與澳大拉西亞航點。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，新加坡航空（Singapore Airlines）的空中巴士 A380 機隊部署計畫包含 10 條主要航線。在其營運的航線網絡架構中，英國倫敦與澳洲雪梨為支撐新加坡航空空中巴士 A380 服務的核心樞紐航點。
除了倫敦與雪梨兩大核心航點外，新加坡航空的空中巴士 A380 航線網絡其餘航點主要由印度與澳大拉西亞（Australasia）地區的航線組成。根據過往報導紀錄，新加坡航空先前亦曾規劃增加約 25% 的空中巴士 A380 航班運量。

en.title: Singapore Airlines Outlines 10 Airbus A380 Routes Anchored by London and Sydney
en.summary: Singapore Airlines operates 10 Airbus A380 routes anchored by London and Sydney, with additional regional flights.
body: According to a report published by Simple Flying, Singapore Airlines has revealed details regarding its network of 10 Airbus A380 routes. The carrier's superjumbo operations are anchored primarily by key long-haul services to London and Sydney, which serve as the foundation of its A380 schedule.

Beyond its core services to London and Sydney, the remainder of the Singapore Airlines Airbus A380 route roster is made up of destinations in India and Australasia. Verified background records note that Singapore Airlines previously planned to expand its Airbus A380 flight departures by 25 percent to support network capacity requirements.

zh.title: 空中巴士A320客機組裝耗時約三週 目標2027年月產75架
zh.summary: 空中巴士A320家族組裝需時約三週；預計2027年達到月產75架目標
body: 根據空中巴士（Airbus）公布的最新營運數據，截至2026年7月，空中巴士A320系列（ICAO機型代碼A320）客機已累計交付12,798架，同時握有20,378架的未交付訂單。針對生產產能規劃，空中巴士在2026年7月單月交付55架A320系列客機，並預計在2027年之前將該單走道客機家族的月產量提升至每月75架。由於目前龐大的訂單積壓，現階段新訂購客機的航空公司在進入實際生產程序前可能需要等待超過三年。

在最終組裝網絡方面，空中巴士在全球設有數個A320系列最終組裝線（FAL）。其中，位於法國土魯斯（Toulouse）的基地擁有兩條單走道客機最終組裝線；位於德國漢堡芬肯維德（Finkenwerder, Hamburg）的基地則設有四條單走道最終組裝線，負責生產包含A321neo與A319neo等機型。此外，空中巴士也在中國天津設有主要服務亞洲航空公司的最終組裝線，以及在美國阿拉巴馬州莫比爾（Mobile, Alabama）設有主要供應北美客戶的最終組裝線。
在主要零組件的跨國分工上，A320系列的大型機身結構分由歐洲四國製造。法國負責製造前機身、駕駛艙與中央翼盒；德國製造中後機身、垂直尾翼、襟翼與貨艙門；英國負責製造機翼；西班牙則生產水平尾翼與翼身整流罩。為了在歐洲各廠區之間運輸這些大型結構組件，空中巴士採用其特有的BelugaXL超級運輸機進行運送，而舊款的BelugaST運輸機已於2026年初正式退役。
當各大主要組件運抵最終組裝線後，一架典型的A320系列客機大約需要三週時間完成最終組裝與測試。在組裝初期，工程團隊會利用精密夾具、自動化鑽孔及鉚接技術將機身段、中央翼盒與機翼相互拼接。隨後，技術團隊會陸續安裝電力、液壓、氣動、航空電子、燃料及空調等主要系統，同時進行機艙內部的隔熱層、行李架、座椅、廚房與洗手間安裝，最後在交付前完成電力測試與各項系統檢查。

en.title: Airbus A320 Family Final Assembly Takes Three Weeks as Target Reaches 75 Monthly
en.summary: Airbus outlines A320 family assembly timeline of three weeks targeting 75 monthly deliveries by 2027.
body: According to operational data published by Airbus, the manufacturer had delivered 12,798 Airbus A320 family (ICAO type code A320) aircraft by July 2026, while maintaining an order backlog of 20,378 aircraft. To meet market demand, Airbus delivered 55 A320 family aircraft in July 2026 alone and is aiming to expand its single-aisle production rate to 75 aircraft per month by 2027. Due to the significant accumulation of existing orders, airlines placing new orders today face potential wait times of over three years before aircraft enter actual production.

Final assembly of the A320 family is distributed across multiple international manufacturing sites. Airbus operates two single-aisle final assembly lines in Toulouse, France, and four single-aisle final assembly lines at Finkenwerder in Hamburg, Germany, which assemble variants including the A321neo and A319neo. Additional assembly lines are located in Tianjin, China, primarily supporting Asian carriers, and in Mobile, Alabama, serving North American customers while also producing the A220.

Major structural components for the A320 family are manufactured across four European nations. France produces the forward fuselage, cockpit, and centre wing box, while Germany manufactures the centre and rear fuselage, vertical tail, flaps, and cargo doors. The wings are produced in the United Kingdom, and Spain manufactures the horizontal tail and wing-to-body fairings. Airbus utilizes its BelugaXL fleet to transport these large components across Europe, following the retirement of the older BelugaST transport aircraft in early 2026.

Once major sections arrive at a final assembly facility, a standard A320 family aircraft requires approximately three weeks to move through final assembly and testing. Initial structural integration joins the fuselage sections, centre wing box, and wings using precision jigs and automated drilling. Over the subsequent stages, technicians install core electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, avionics, fuel, and environmental control systems, alongside interior cabin fittings such as seats, overhead bins, galleys, and lavatories, prior to final power-up testing and pre-delivery checks.
